summary: The sheet layout fits the constrained viewport, but the MaterialTokens preview exhibits severe text overlapping and alignment issues inside the glass specimen stack.

issues.title: Overlapping specimen text
issues.description: Specimen text layers collide and overlap directly inside the preview pill container, making the labels unreadable.
issues.evidence: Stacked text rows ('specimen 01' through 'specimen 06') render on top of each other over the first pill layer.
issues.suggestion: Adjust line-height and vertical spacing so each specimen label aligns neatly with its respective material tier pill.
